messages:
elena: Quick sync — I just opened PR 20456 to add the private deployment schedule + canary window for the on‑prem package. Need runtime + infra + security approvals before we can schedule the Dedicated->Private sync next week. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/20456
samir: Looks okay at a glance. Main change is autoscaler cooldown tweak and a new canary flag?
elena: yeah, autoscale cooldown + eviction fallback header. also added a serviceAccount change for the onprem agent.
maya: pinging runtime team for eyes @runtime-team — can we confirm the KV cache warmup won't regress cold-starts? :eyes:
ton: taking a look. can we add a short perf test in the PR that runs the startup timeline (infra/test/startup.sh)?
elena: added the script run in the CI config; it's optional but will post artifacts when CI runs.
ci-bot: CI queued — running unit tests, lint, integration/startup
samir: infra: need confirmation that the serviceAccount change doesn't bump required IAM perms. @jonah-infra
jonah: iam: change is read-only + annotate. i can sign off but want security to confirm KMS/HSM usage for private keys.
security-bot: Notifying #sec-approvals for manual review.
elena: tagging @sec-sara for KMS/HSM check — we added an env var to allow customer-managed KMS for on‑prem deploys.
elena: timeline: hoping to merge by Thu EOD to start canary Mon. if any blockers please call them out.
maya: runtime: ran the quick startup script locally — warmup looks fine but saw a small spike in memory during kv load. leaving a review comment with the heap snapshot.
ton: infra: +1 on test script; left minor comment on logging path.
jonah: infra +1 pending sec ack
sec-sara: picking this up, will review KMS config and give ack by EOD. if we need a short threat-model note, ping me.
elena: awesome, thanks. one ask: if security approves, can platform schedule the canary slot and reserve capacity? cc @samir
samir: yes, can schedule once sec ack is in. i'll tentatively reserve Mon morning slot but will unlock if we get a regression.
elena: thanks all. I'll resolve minor comments and re-run CI after addressing them. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: CI passed — unit tests OK, startup test artifacts uploaded: https://ci.redwood.com/artifacts/20456/startup.zip
elena: marking this for merge when sec-sara gives ack. follow-ups: I'll open a runbook update for private deploy checklist.
sec-sara: acked — KMS config looks good. one note: add KMS rotation interval to docs. +approved.
elena: merging now. thanks everyone! :rocket:
